title: Smooth $\%$MinMax: A Differentiable Relaxation for Codon Harmonization
abstract: arXiv:2607.03881v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Codon harmonization aims to adapt the coding sequences for heterologous expression while preserving the native-like patterns of frequent and rare codons that may influence local translation dynamics and co-translational protein folding. However, widely used harmonization metrics, such as $\%$MinMax, are defined on discrete codon sequences and are, therefore, not readily compatible with gradient-based neural codon design. Here, we introduce Smooth $\%$MinMax, denoted as $\%{\rm MinMax}_{(s)}$, a differentiable relaxation of the conventional hard $\%$MinMax metric, denoted as $\%{\rm MinMax}_{(h)}$. $\%{\rm MinMax}_{(s)}$ replaces the discrete codon-usage values with probability-weighted synonymous-codon usage values and replaces the hard $\%$Max/$\%$Min branch with a sigmoid-gated interpolation. This formulation preserves the signed interpretation of $\%{\rm MinMax}_{(h)}$, while enabling optimization with respect to the synonym

translated_title: 平滑%MinMax：密码子协调的可微松弛方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.03881v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：密码子协调旨在调整编码序列以进行异源表达，同时保留可能影响局部翻译动力学和共翻译蛋白折叠的频繁和稀有密码子的天然样模式。然而，广泛使用的协调度量，如%MinMax，定义在离散密码子序列上，因此不易与基于梯度的神经密码子设计兼容。在此，我们引入平滑%MinMax，记为%MinMax_(s)，它是传统硬%MinMax度量（记为%MinMax_(h)）的可微松弛。%MinMax_(s)将离散密码子使用值替换为概率加权的同义密码子使用值，并将硬%Max/%Min分支替换为sigmoid门控插值。该公式保留了%MinMax_(h)的符号解释，同时支持关于同义词的优化。
tldr: 我们提出了一种名为平滑%MinMax的可微松弛方法，它替代了传统的离散%MinMax度量，使得密码子协调能够通过梯度优化进行，同时保留原度量的符号语义。
en_tdlr: We introduce Smooth %MinMax, a differentiable relaxation of the discrete %MinMax metric, enabling gradient-based optimization for codon harmonization while preserving its signed interpretation.
